{{Top|leg}}
'''Kiirloor''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] settlement that was established on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Wyrd]] wanted to destroy it, as it was too close to one of their bases, so they used a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] artifact to try and make the extinct [[Cloud Mountain]] volcano erupt and destroy the settlement. The Wyrd were defeated by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], but the settlement was badly damaged, so the Wookiees relocated it to a different area of Cularin.
